| Category = Rice recipes
| Servings = 2
| Time = 30 minutes
| Difficulty = 3
}}
{{nutritionsummary|½ of recipe (480 g)|2|472|50|5.5 g|1.6 g|128 mg|1231 mg|92.2 g|6.3 g|2.2 g|13.5 g|5%|4%|6%|11%}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|Cuisine of India]]

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]/8.8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) uncooked [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* 1 small (a little bit bigger than a golf ball) [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 2 medium-sized green [[Cookbook:Chili Pepper|chile peppers]], chopped
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]] paste
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] paste
* ¼ teaspoon spice blend (the blend ratio should be like ½ stick of [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] : 3 [[Cookbook:Cardamom|cardamon]] pods : 6 [[Cookbook:Clove|cloves]])
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Eggs|eggs]], beaten

==Procedure==
#Cook [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]] and keep it aside.
#[[Cookbook:Sweating|Sweat]] onions and green chilies in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|pan]] together over medium heat.
#Add ginger and garlic pastes.
#Add rice, and mix everything well.
#Add salt and spice powder.
#Stir in the beaten eggs.
#Cook until everything is mixed well.
